Description: Charts and indicators for any stock
As a user I want a candlestick chart for a ticker so I can see price action
Acceptance Criteria: Given a valid ticker then a candlestick chart with volume loads in under 5s; invalid ticker shows an error message

Description: As a user I want indicators on the chart so I can judge trend and momentum
Acceptance Criteria: SMA20/50 and RSI are shown; trend summary says uptrend/downtrend and overbought/oversold

Description: As a user I want to choose the time period
Company financials and valuation
As a user I want P/E EPS margin and market cap
Acceptance Criteria: Table of key metrics is shown for a valid ticker; missing values show None

Description: As a user I want income statement balance sheet and cash flow
Acceptance Criteria: All three statements load as tables

Description: Python-powered comparisons and projections
As a user I want to compare stocks on return and risk
Acceptance Criteria: Table shows return volatility and max drawdown for 2+ tickers

Description: As a user I want to see how my money could grow
Acceptance Criteria: Chart and 3 scenarios shown; assumptions are displayed

Description: Conversational UI with explanations
As a user I want to ask questions in plain language
Acceptance Criteria: Chat keeps history; errors are shown politely

Description: As a user I want the AI to fetch data itself
Acceptance Criteria: AI calls the right tool and explains result with source and assumptions

Description: As a user I want to know data source and limits
Acceptance Criteria: Every answer names the source and says not financial advice

Description: Harness MCP sandbox and workers
As a developer I want a controlled tool loop with permissions
Acceptance Criteria: Only whitelisted tools run; loop stops after 6 rounds

Description: As a developer I want safe code execution
Acceptance Criteria: Code runs with 10s timeout; dangerous imports are blocked

Description: As a user I want long analyses to run in background
Acceptance Criteria: Task shows progress; retries 3 times on failure; result is saved

Description: As a team we want automatic checks
Acceptance Criteria: GitHub Action runs flake8 and pytest on every pull request

Description: Boards diagram and presentation
Research journeys wireframes and system flow
AWS-style diagram
Acceptance Criteria: Shows services data flow workers queue and sandbox
